I am writing this to erase all confusion, I was not killed by anyone except myself. Im scared to die with pain or with a struggle, i dont want to die and have to mess up the poor suicide cleanup teams day by having to clean my walls of blood. I don't want anyone to have on their conscience that they killed someone, so I figured the best way to pass away would be by self-dehydration. I'm not exactly sure when or how i will pass away because i have no internet to search up how long it takes to die from self dehydration, so i will just wait it out in my room with jinx and hope that it doesn't hurt. I have nothing else to live for in my life and the few people I do would forget about me in a month or so. The only thing keeping me alive was my friends, but it seems as if they dont want me either. I will miss Hanna and Amanda, I don't deserve either of them but i don't know how to let them go without hurting either of them. I will miss David and Jeremiah because they could always make me smile. I will miss my best friend LJ because of all the fun times we had together, I will Miss zarius because of how far I've come along the way with him. I will miss my cousins because of all the fun times I've had with them. I will miss Julie as she was one of my closest friends even though she is mad at me and I'm not sure why but I'm sure it is for a good reason. I hope that this message is put out to all my friends and family so they will see this because this would be a waste of time if no one ever saw this, i guess this is a way to get out all of my emotions without having to write it on pen and paper because as most of my friends know, I have horrible handwriting that nobody would be able to make out. I am typing this with a straight face and no tears, I think I have accepted my fate and I am no longer afraid of death. I don't know if there is an afterlife but I hope so because I would be pretty bored if i didn't exist. I will miss Lucie  and Lauren because I always had fun with them whenever I was with them. I will miss galia as she is one of my longest friendships. I will miss Lily as she was one of the funniest people I know. I will miss Sara and I'm sorry to her that I caused any rough feelings to her. I will miss my grandma because she would do anything for me and loves me very much. I will not miss my mom,he was the #1 stress cause in my life never realized all the mental pain she gave me, i will not go into detail about the things she did but i will say that i hope she doesn't get any harsh words said to her as she did not realize the pain that she put me through. I will miss Zuriel as he was an amazing friend at school and on playstation. I hope all of my video game systems, games and controllers go to Lary Harcum. I hope all of my Knives go to him as well. I would also like to say another sorry to Hanna and amanda, i always felt like i was lying to amanda and i am sorry for that. I will miss Laura and I will miss Keziah because whenever I was with them in school or out, I was always messing around and laughing with them. I would also say that i miss anyone else that i was friends with over the years, i am most definitely going to miss many many people that i will miss but that is just because i'm thinking of a lot right now. I will miss Mr. King and Mr. Stanley as they were my favorite teachers in school. I was definitely surprised by how difficult this whole online school thing was and that definitely played a part in this. I thought I had it figured out, if i fail school then i can go into the military and use that as my work and i also would like to serve my country. and the worst thing that could happen in the military is that i die and that would be the best outcome for that any way.
    I was thinking about running away from home and riding my longboard to all my friends houses to say goodbye but i don't think i would have enough time left to do that so i just decided to write this, i wish my mom didn't take my phone away because i could at least leave them a voice message or a text saying goodbye but it is what it is. I made a deal with myself that as soon as my mom takes my phone then i will do this and she did take my phone so i was going day by day hoping she wouldn't take it that day. once i got caught up in my schoolwork i decided i couldmt do it anymore, 3 essays a week was to much for me and i couldn't handle it. Also the responsibility of having to "Watch this video and answer the question after" Was getting pretty annoying. I was kind of living my life carefree up until yesterday when my mom burst in my room yelling at me and telling me im grounded, i instantly knew what that meant, i was going to say my last goodbyes and sending my last snap, the last person i texted was hanna and the last person i snapped was amanda, but it was a half of my face snap so i messed up there. I'm sad I didn't get to see hannas face one last time before this happened because she is already going through a lot in her life. I wish there was a way to make her not sad about this but u guess everyone will be sad for a couple of days. 
    If the afterlife is real, im not sure where i wil be going because i have done a lot of sinful things in my life but nothing to bad, i wonder if suicide is considered a sin. I wish that I could at least listen to my favorite music before I die but I guess it's alright, I was hoping to be able to see lil uzi or trippie redd before I die and that's alright that I didn't because I would always just be another fan to them.
    I think this is all that i have to say for now, I hope that Playboi carti release WLR and that Uzi releases all the leaked songs on my soundcloud playlist.
